requirement.applicantContext: Undergraduate degree applicants reviewing the general 2026/2027 IGCSE and IB route
requirement.conditions: Section 1.4.2.1 recognises the IGCSE and IB route. The published general regulation provides no numeric diploma total. Confirm programme prerequisites and any Senate equivalence requirements.
